Open Plugin Market

DeepSeek Harness is built on the idea that everything can be a plugin, but it offers no official plugin list or recommendations, so finding good plugins was up to you. On October 15 the official plugin market began accepting third-party indexes, so we built this one.

How to connect

  1. Turn on the market

    In Plugins → Experimental plugins, enable Custom plugin markets.

  2. Add an index source

    Open Discover and choose Add index source.

  3. Paste the URL

    Add the address above, then browse and install plugins.

  • 11 categories
